notes:
• The Updates window says what's new in a release, with every change a click away, and shows it again after the app updates itself.
• When you run out of Zerg Router usage, ZTC stops and says why and when your limit resets, instead of retrying for minutes.
• Signed in with Zerg Router, /usage and the status bar show your Router budget.
• If a Codex error reply breaks off, ZTC still shows the error code, renews a rejected sign-in and retries, or says to sign in again.
changes: The desktop Updates window says what's new.
Your Zerg Router budget, where you can see it.
A Codex error reply that breaks off no longer hides the error.
Out of Zerg Router usage, ZTC stops and says so.
Unattended runs exit 4 on a Zerg Router refusal, and a relaunch loop can't hammer Router.
